newsitem.title: UK: EUROTUNNEL SUSPENDS SHARES IN LONDON.
newsitem.headline: EUROTUNNEL SUSPENDS SHARES IN LONDON.

text.p: Channel tunnel operator Eurotunnel Plc said on Monday it had asked for a temporary suspension of its shares in London, pending a further announcmeent.
It has also requested that its share listings in Paris and Brussels also be suspended.

The suspension follows a report on Monday in The Times newspaper which said the 26 lenders of the Anglo-French tunnel oeprator were meeting on Friday to look at the latest proposals for dealing with the company's debt mountain.
The report said the meeting would be the first after the end of the mandate for the two mediators appointed by the French court to examine the issue.
Last week a source close to the talks, told Reuters that it was unlikely Eurotunnel would ask for an extension of the mandate, which ends Monday.
